failure_patterns.pattern: endpoint_selection_or_redundancy: Some calls used an endpoint with the wrong input or result shape, reduced a requested check to a different target, or added overlapping calls that did not cover a distinct requested facet.

rejected_edits.content: - Preserve the granularity of the requested target when choosing an endpoint: for a check on a complete identifier, prefer an endpoint that accepts and checks that complete identifier. Do not reduce it to a component (for example, an email address to its domain) unless the user requested a component-level check or the schema requires that conversion.

- Choose the smallest complementary set of calls that covers the requested checks and facets. A request to use multiple tools calls for distinct, complementary checks; it does not require calling every overlapping validator. Add another endpoint for the same facet only when independent cross-checks or multiple sources are explicitly requested.
